integrity: Kappa is reconstructed independently from its observed-versus-expected-agreement definition and from an exact closed rational form. Every admissible table through the first boundary is exhaustively enumerated with exact arithmetic, and the persistent family is proved symbolically rather than inferred from finite computation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns binary diagnostic agreement tables with fixed reference prevalence, all four cells positive, and positive Cohen kappa. The cutoff is a small-sample structural statement and does not address estimation uncertainty or the broader choice among diagnostic performance measures.
title: Positive-kappa accuracy reversal first occurs at ten binary cases
